reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are exactly what I wanted to see, and I could check the number on the box myself. The launch price of $24.99 is an easy impulse buy, and the empty-box guarantee lowers the risk, even though I already have too many half-used bottles.
objection: I have a drawer full of half-used supplements, so I worry this ends up there too. I also want to open the report and see that it is real and not just a pretty PDF.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not match the batch number, or the lab turned out to be unnamed or paid by the brand, I would skip it.
